finalText:
**Big, but mostly mechanical.** `account_id` appears 1291 times across 94 files.

The 75 service files are internal names. Those are safe to rename.

Four places must keep the old name:

| Where | Why |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public API, marked frozen |
| `lib/serialize.js` wire values | The name clients read |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk`, 4 files | Wiped by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| `migrations`, 12 files | All already ran in production |

The database column is still `account_id`. A new migration must rename it first.
